
== Events and participants (Datacard Grok) ==
'''Build notes:''' Participant lists are every name in the weekly pairing posts of each event thread on forum.starwarsccg.org (BYEs dropped). Obvious pairing typos were normalized (e.g. "Dennius Rambaud", "Jared Greewald", "Thomas Santouosso"). Pairing names "Jonathan Chu", "Matthew Fendt" and "Stephen Sanders" are linked to [[Jonny Chu]], [[Matt Fendt]] and [[Steve Sanders]] (inference: same thread/standings use the short names). Plain text = no person page.
'''Missing data:''' Final standings are screenshots/PDF attachments, not readable text. No sourced winner for 2024 Event 3 (prize thread: 1st-place sheet "passes down to Bowman", 2nd Feldman, 3rd Dusel), 2025 Event 2, 2026 Prelude, Events 2–4. No 2026 Event 3/4 forum threads found in f=1387. Classic No-V has no format page.
